notes: Format-constrained enumeration probe: honor a compact duty-roster gate (never brute-force the full serial space), apply the exact well-formed-keycard predicate (exact length, required prefix/suffix fragments, uppercase+digits only) to every rostered emission — including near-miss decoys (off-by-one length, lowercase prefix/body, dash separator) and valid tokens riddled with the confusable characters O/0/I/1 that punish over-tightening — write EVERY retained candidate to the result file in ascending serial order, and only then select the unique SHA-256 residue match as the vault keycard. The solver is reusable: the verifier re-runs it unchanged on hidden generator modules with different serial ranges, lengths, fragments, alphabets and pins, and re-derives the expected candidate list and selection independently. Hard: the failure mode is precisely dropping the matching candidate by tightening the format (or guessing the final value instead of enumerating), and the hidden modules break any hard-coded format constant.
